requirement.description: Switch class incorrectly handles case processing, causing AttributeError when accessing 'items' attribute on list objects instead of dictionaries.
requirement.contract: Fix the Switch class constructor to properly process case arguments so that cases are stored as tuples rather than lists, eliminating the AttributeError when iterating through cases.

requirement.description: Memory class missing proper initialization of MemoryData import or incorrect reference causing NameError in multiple tests.
requirement.contract: Add proper import or reference to MemoryData class in the Memory module to resolve NameError: name 'MemoryData' is not defined.

requirement.description: Instance class missing ports attribute that tests expect to access, causing AttributeError when accessing 'ports' attribute.
requirement.contract: Add a ports property or attribute to the Instance class to resolve AttributeError: 'Instance' object has no attribute 'ports'.

requirement.description: Memory class constructor missing proper handling of the 'simulate' parameter causing NameError when trying to access undefined variables.
requirement.contract: Update Memory class constructor to properly handle the simulate parameter and related initialization logic to prevent NameError.

requirement.description: Switch class constructor has incorrect dictionary processing logic causing AttributeError when processing cases.
requirement.contract: Fix the Switch class constructor to properly process case arguments and store them correctly as ordered dictionaries instead of lists.
